benchmark_entry.name: Forward-Rate Agreement: Value and Fair Simple Forward Rate
benchmark_entry.description: For zero-coupon discount factors P1=P(0,T1), P2=P(0,T2) (P2>0, accrual delta != 0) and the simple forward rate F=(P1/P2-1)/delta: F is the no-arbitrage rate P1=P2*(1+delta*F), the FRA value delta*P2*(F-K) equals the floating leg minus the fixed leg (P1-P2)-delta*K*P2, and it vanishes exactly at the fair rate K=F.

code.lean:
import MathFin.FixedIncome.FRA

open MathFin

/-- FRA value and fair simple forward rate: no-arbitrage rate, value as
    floating-minus-fixed leg, and zero value exactly at K = F. -/
theorem mf_fi_fra {P₁ P₂ δ K F : ℝ} (hP₂ : 0 < P₂) (hδ : δ ≠ 0)
    (hF : F = (P₁ / P₂ - 1) / δ) :
    P₁ = P₂ * (1 + δ * F) ∧
    δ * P₂ * (F - K) = (P₁ - P₂) - δ * K * P₂ ∧
    (δ * P₂ * (F - K) = 0 ↔ K = F) :=
  MathFin.fra_value_and_fair_rate hP₂ hδ hF

benchmark_entry.name: Contango / Backwardation Sign Structure
benchmark_entry.description: For the cost-of-carry forward F(T) = S*e^{(r-delta)T}: contango F>S iff r>delta, backwardation F<S iff r<delta, and basis convergence F(0)=S.

code.lean:
import MathFin.Futures.Contango

open MathFin

/-- Contango/backwardation sign structure + basis convergence for the
    cost-of-carry forward F(T) = S*exp((r-delta)T). -/
theorem mf_futures_contango {S r delta T : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hT : 0 < T) :
    (S < S * Real.exp ((r - delta) * T) ↔ delta < r) ∧
    (S * Real.exp ((r - delta) * T) < S ↔ r < delta) ∧
    S * Real.exp ((r - delta) * 0) = S :=
  MathFin.contango_backwardation_basis hS hT
